Summary: HOSP-01 - Find a doctor by specialty
Description: As a patient, I want to find doctors by specialty so that I can choose an appropriate clinician.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

Description: As a patient, I want to view available appointment slots so that I can select a convenient time.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a doctor has published availability, When I view the doctor's schedule, Then only open appointment slots are shown.

Description: As a patient, I want to book an available slot so that I can secure an appointment.
Acceptance Criteria: Given the selected slot is still available, When I confirm booking, Then the appointment is saved and a booking reference is displayed. Given another patient has taken the slot, When I confirm booking, Then the booking is rejected, availability is refreshed and I am asked to select another slot.

Description: As a patient, I want to view my upcoming appointments so that I can remember my scheduled visits.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

Description: As a patient, I want to choose a new available slot for an existing appointment so that I can change my visit time.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

Description: As a patient, I want to cancel an appointment so that the slot can be made available to another patient.
Acceptance Criteria: Given I have a cancellable future appointment, When I confirm cancellation, Then its status becomes Cancelled and the slot is released. Given the appointment is already completed, When I attempt cancellation, Then the portal prevents the action and explains why.

Description: As a patient, I want a booking confirmation notification so that I have a record of my appointment.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

Description: As a patient, I want a reminder before my appointment so that I can plan to attend.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

Description: As a patient, I want an alert when my appointment changes or is cancelled so that I know the latest schedule.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

Description: As a doctor, I want to publish my working hours so that patients can book suitable slots.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

Description: As a doctor, I want to block leave or unavailable time so that patients cannot book during it.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

Description: As a clinic administrator, I want the schedule to prevent overlapping appointments so that doctor time is not double-booked.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.
